correctness_confidence.basis: All four main theorems, algebraic derivations, external path length inductions, polyhedron midpoint injectivity, Moore BFS counts, and exact integer thresholds (589^64+1, 83,522, 209,953) check out cleanly.

rigor.basis: All four main theorems, algebraic derivations, external path length inductions, polyhedron midpoint injectivity, Moore BFS counts, and exact integer thresholds (589^64+1, 83,522, 209,953) are mathematically sound. Minor scope caveats: Theorem 3.1 formalizes union-find rather than MST directly, and replacing e=64 by 4 assumes [7] only needs t log^4(t+2) absorption.

novelty.basis: Provides tight new characterizations for four open parameters in Gholami-Hajiaghayi [7], notably the two-sided K_crit(alpha) = 2/(1-alpha) bound with 3-vertex witness, arbitrary p-band tower conservation, an unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) octave-decision lower bound, and exact finite crossovers. Though each proof uses standard tools, the synthesis is original and illuminating.

significance.basis: Pinpoints opaque-register dyadic octave classification—rather than union-find—as the true source of the log log log n term in [7], halves the critical-edge witness path length, cuts Lemma 8.2's bottleneck constants by 4x and 16x, and lowers Algorithm 8's non-asymptotic crossover by over 172 orders of magnitude into the practical regime.

reproducibility.basis: Documents a clean three-layer verification pipeline: 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems with zero sorry or Classical.choice, an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier with 16 SHA-256 certificates, and 56 pytest adversarial checks, while honestly scoping Lean coverage to algebraic and arithmetic kernels (code not executed in this PDF-only review).

summary: This paper resolves four structural questions around Gholami and Hajiaghayi's O(m + n log log log n) SSSP algorithm: it halves the radial excursion threshold (K_crit = 2/(1-alpha)), generalizes p-band union-find conservation, proves an unconditional Omega(N log log log N) Las Vegas octave-decision barrier, and reduces Algorithm 8's outer guard from 589^64+1 to 83,522. The proofs are sound, well-presented, and transparently backed by Lean 4 arithmetic kernels and exact-rational verification.
strengths: Exact two-sided radial excursion threshold K_crit(alpha) = 2/(1-alpha) with 3-vertex tight witness and K=8 vs K=16 sharpening.
Unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) linear-decision-tree barrier isolating octave classification as the true bottleneck.
Exact Lean-certified 172-order-of-magnitude outer threshold drop from 589^64+1 to 83,522.
weaknesses: Theorem 3.1 formalizes union-find directly rather than MST.
Replacing e=64 by 4 relies on outer-hierarchy steps absorbing t log^4(t+2).
strong_novelty_candidates: Two-sided radial excursion threshold K_crit(alpha) = 2/(1-alpha) with 3-vertex tightness.
Unconditional Las Vegas Omega(N log log log N) octave-decision lower bound.
Exact 172-order-of-magnitude outer threshold reduction N_0(64) = 589^64+1 to N_0(4) = 83,522.
